num_periods: <int> Number of discrete time periods in the planning horizon.
num_warehouses: <int> Number of warehouses in the distribution network.
num_retailers: <int> Number of retailers served by the warehouses.
num_scenarios: <int> Number of demand scenarios representing uncertainty.
initial_inventory: <int> Starting inventory level at all facilities at the beginning of the planning horizon.
initial_setups_imposed: <bool> Whether all facilities must be activated in the first period.
retailer_to_warehouse: <list[int], length num_retailers> Index of the warehouse that exclusively supplies each retailer.
scenario_probabilities: <list[float], length num_scenarios> Probability of occurrence for each demand scenario.
holding_cost_plant: <float> Per-unit per-period cost of holding inventory at the plant.
holding_cost_warehouse: <float> Per-unit per-period cost of holding inventory at each warehouse.
holding_costs_retailers: <list[float], length num_retailers> Per-unit per-period cost of holding inventory at each retailer.
setup_costs_plant: <list[int], length num_periods> Fixed cost incurred when the plant is activated for production in each period.
setup_costs_warehouses: <list[list[int]], shape [num_warehouses][num_periods]> Fixed cost incurred when each warehouse is activated for ordering in each period.
setup_costs_retailers: <list[list[int]], shape [num_retailers][num_periods]> Fixed cost incurred when each retailer is activated for ordering in each period.
demands: <list[list[list[int]]], shape [num_scenarios][num_retailers][num_periods]> Quantity of product demanded by each retailer in each period under each scenario.
